headline_seed: Live Updates: Iran dismisses Trump's "economic D-Day" threat, says it "will only bring further defeat" - CBS News
draft_text:
Iran's FM Araghchi called Trump's "Economic D-Day" a "diversion," citing US debt. Treasury's Bessent told CNBC the plan is a "one-two punch" — blockade plus "toughest sanctions in history."

And that's the mews.
